summary: Tested P3 Custom Tenant Branding feature end-to-end. Backend endpoints (GET/PUT/reset) work correctly and persist to MongoDB. Frontend page loads via /tools/branding with all sections (Department Logo, Color Scheme with 3 color pickers, Quick Presets, Live Preview). Preset click (Navy Blue) updates all 3 colors correctly. Save Changes and Reset to Defaults both work with proper toasts. Live Preview reflects color changes in real-time. All 6 acceptance criteria verified.

minor.issue: When tenant settings has explicit primary_color=None (rather than missing key), the endpoint returns null instead of default '#dc2626'. Root cause: settings.get('primary_color', '#dc2626') returns None if key exists with None value. Fix: use `settings.get('primary_color') or '#dc2626'`. Same applies to secondary_color and accent_color. Impact: fresh tenants that were created with TenantSettings model containing None values will see null colors in initial GET before any PUT.

action_items: Consider fixing minor GET branding fallback to handle explicit None values: use `settings.get('primary_color') or '#dc2626'` in tenant_routes.py get_current_tenant_branding endpoint (lines 143-145).
critical_code_review_comments: tenant_routes.py: `settings.get(key, default)` pattern breaks when key exists with None value - use `or` fallback for safety.
BrandingSettingsPage.js is 490 lines - acceptable size, well-structured.
Logo upload uses base64 stored in MongoDB - fine for small logos (2MB limit enforced client-side) but no server-side size validation on PUT /api/tenants/branding (potential DoS vector).
PUT /api/tenants/branding accepts any hex string without regex validation - could allow injection of invalid CSS via the color field.
seed_data_creation: None; used existing Medina County tenant. Branding was reset to defaults after tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Branding feature fully functional. Only minor issue: GET returns null when tenant.settings has explicit None color values instead of defaulting. All CRUD works. UI page at /tools/branding with data-testids: preset-{key}, primary-color-input, secondary-color-input, accent-color-input, save-branding-btn, reset-branding-btn, upload-logo-btn, remove-logo-btn, logo-file-input, nav-branding.
